title: Pharmacokinetics (PK) Study of a Fluconazole Loading Dose in Infants and Toddlers
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the pharmacokinetics and safety of a fluconazole loading dose in infants and toddlers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* suspected sepsis with blood culture within 48 hours
* age ≥ 48 hours and \< 2 years of age
* sufficient venous access to permit study drug administration

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergic reaction to azole
* history of fluconazole administration in prior 5 days
* liver dysfunction
* renal failure
* concomitant use of cyclosporine, tacrolimus, or azithromycin
